profile.headline: Software Engineer · Cloud & Full-Stack · TypeScript, React, Node.js, PostgreSQL, AWS · Healthcare systems
profile.summary:
Hi, I'm Nyala. Thanks for visiting my profile! I'm a software engineer building cloud and full-stack systems in healthcare, where the data is sensitive and mistakes are expensive. Since February 2026, I've helped a regulated company move to AWS: migration tooling with verified integrity, an identity-reconciliation engine that turned ~31k fragmented records into 16k verified profiles, and a React document portal that keeps sensitive files entirely off application servers.

Before that, I was a backend engineer at Koddi (C#, MSSQL, AWS), and in college, I built educational VR applications through research internships (Unity, React 360). BA in Computer Science from Vassar · AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate and Cloud Practitioner · CompTIA ITF+ · Per Scholas full-stack program, 2025.

I care about understanding a system completely before touching it in production, and about leaving data more trustworthy than I found it. Interested in health tech, ed tech, and games.

I'd love to connect about opportunities or collaborations!

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Cloud Infrastructure Modernization: Co-led the technical modernization of a HIPAA-regulated infrastructure to a cloud-native AWS architecture (EC2, S3, RDS), focusing on RBAC security and PHI data decoupling.

- High-Integrity Data Migration: Engineered a hybrid Bash and Node.js migration engine that moved ~10k sensitive documents into AWS S3, streaming between storage APIs to avoid filesystem bottlenecks, with every migrated record verified for integrity.

- Identity Resolution & Consolidation: Built a PII-safe reconciliation engine in TypeScript using multi-factor fingerprinting on stable identifiers; consolidated ~31k fragmented records into 16k verified profiles (−47% redundancy) while preserving every document link.

- Secure Document Architecture: Architected a React 19 portal featuring a secure "triple-handshake" upload flow via S3 Presigned URLs. Ensured sensitive PHI bypasses application servers entirely, minimizing the security attack surface and reducing server overhead.

- Advanced Search & Contract Management: Developed a live, debounced search for Patient and Caregiver entities using SQL window functions and PostgreSQL. Built a specialized module for Insurance Contract management, enabling organized tracking of master agreements and rate schedules.

- Data Integration & HIPAA Compliance: Developed ETL utilities to bulk import and "hydrate" profile data from third-party reporting exports. Integrated immutable HIPAA Audit Logs to track all file interactions, PII disclosures, and metadata edits for strict regulatory compliance.

- Reliability & DevOps: Developed a suite of idempotent recovery scripts for production database operations, including automated asset re-parenting and metadata healing, ensuring a seamless cutover with zero data loss.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Infrastructure · Engineering · React · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · PostgreSQL · Full-Stack Development · Cloud Migration · Cloud Infrastructure
